metric.name: log_speedup_vs_ref_speedup
metric.formula: reward = min(1.0, ln(speedup/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if speedup > ref_speedup else 0.0; range [0,1]
metric.speedup: ABBA paired: baseline and candidate suites run ALTERNATELY for 5 pairs in fresh sub-processes; per pair ratio = geomean over the 8 hidden timed cases of baseline_ms/candidate_ms (== geomean_sol_fraction(cand)/geomean_sol_fraction(base), the per-case T_SOL cancels); speedup = median over pairs
metric.sol_fraction_definition: per case sol_fraction = T_SOL / t_call ; T_SOL = min_causal_FLOPs / measured_dense_bf16_peak ; min_causal_FLOPs = sum_i 4*num_q_heads*head_size*L_i*(L_i+1)/2 ; t_call = harness CUDA-event median over timed blocks
metric.anchor_semantics: speedup == ref_speedup -> 0.0 (must EXCEED it to score) ; speedup >= ref_speedup^2 (2.3461) -> 1.0 ; speedup <= 1 -> 0
metric.migrated_from: sol_fraction_geomean_vs_strong_baseline, reward = geomean(candidate)/geomean(strong_baseline), open-ended NO cap (superseded 2026-07-27 by MOD_SPEC v1 改动 2A / reward.md)
metric.peak_measurement_note: cuBLAS 8192^3 bf16, best-of-30, measured FOUR times on NVIDIA H20: 137.726 / 137.905 / 137.985 (this task's three sessions) and 138.14 (the sibling d123 slice) -> spread 0.30%. The constant is fixed at 137.94; because the reward is a RATIO of two geomeans measured in the same run, the constant cancels from the score and only sets the reported absolute fraction.

strong_baseline.description: torch built-in FlashAttention-2 varlen (aten::_flash_attention_forward with cu_seqlens, is_causal=True) — the strongest off-the-shelf varlen causal prefill kernel in the image

quality_gate.parity_measure: per query row: max elementwise |candidate-fp32_reference| / (RMS of that row's fp32 reference)
quality_gate.parity_calibration: measured worst across FOUR independent correct implementations (FA2 varlen, a hand-written Triton kernel, per-sequence SDPA, chunked fp32 torch) over the timed suite INCLUDING two full-tensor cases and the 12-case edge suite = 0.0205 -> the tolerance sits 4.9x above it
anticheat: stale/memoisation probe (3 different workloads per case must give 3 different correct outputs)
input immutability (q/k/v bit-identical after the call)
plausibility hard-fail above 1.15 of the measured dense peak
